instruction: The opened file `base.SchDot` is the starting template. Create a custom title-block template with six auto-populated fields and save it as `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\custom.SchDot`. Requirements: - Read `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\metadata.json` and write its 6 key-value pairs into the template as Parameters: `Title`, `Designer`, `Revision`, `CheckedBy`, `Date`, and `ProjectNumber`. Each Parameter Value must exactly match `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\metadata.json`, including case, punctuation, and spaces. - Place the 6 Parameters within the visible area of an ANSI B Landscape sheet. Coordinates are in mil, and the legal range is `X in [0, 11500]`, `Y in [0, 7500]`, avoiding the lower-right title-block band and the page boundary. The six Parameters must all have distinct coordinates. - Use the template's default font for all six Parameters, i.e. `FontId = 0`, referencing `Font0` from `[FontTable]`. - Keep all other settings identical to `base.SchDot` and only add the new Parameter sections.
